cultural.vision_reason: The photo documents a Hill Anga woman in traditional dress and ornaments (waist-fringe, arm and neck ornaments, ear-plug), carrying a child in a hide sling, against a mud-wall backdrop — a documentary ethnographic photo consistent with the claimed people.

physical.title: photographic print
physical.summary:
Nigeria, half-length, three-quarter portrait of Hill Anga adult female. Carrying young child in animal-hide [?] sling on back. Female wearing waist-ornament with bunches of string or leaves at back and front, arm-ornaments, neck-ornament, ear-plug, narrow head-band. Mud wall as backdrop.
edium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.




. Small group of adult females and a child, sitting on ground outdoors. Wearing personal-ornaments including disc-shaped lip-plugs and ear-plugs, bowl-shaped hair-styles. Two females dressing hair of other two females, using small pointed tools. Female at right holding young child.
Medium: Gelatin silver print.
Format: One of four prints mounted on album page.
